world.prompt: Create ONE finished wide navigation banner image for Unit 5 of a preschool English learning app. OUTPUT canvas wide 3:1, ideally 1536x512. Reference image 1 (Unit4 Family Park) is the exact STYLE and LAYOUT reference: glossy cyan rounded frame, bright azure sky, puffy clouds, emerald grass, yellow badge top left, large playful bold rounded white/yellow lettering with thick navy outline, clean dimensional illustrated mobile-game finish. Do not copy its family cast. Images 2-4 are CHARACTER IDENTITY references for our Unit5 children: curly brown-haired boy in coral pocket t-shirt and blue shorts; brown pigtail girl in purple and coral; blonde girl in lavender coat. Render these same clothing/hair identities in the clean modeled style, all friendly, with the happy smiling boy prominent at right and the two girls beside him, a colorful little playhouse behind them. Left 52 percent is legible typographic design: yellow star badge reads exactly 'Unit 5'; main large title reads exactly "He's happy!"; white book badge below reads exactly '6 lessons'. Do not add any other words or any screenshot/cream-card background. Entire banner fills the wide canvas with very small transparent corner margins only. All lettering, faces and cyan frame fully visible, no clipping. The joyful illustrated characters take right half, not tiny icons. Make this visually belong next to the supplied Unit4 banner.
